Returns 400 with DB error (invalid UUID syntax) for non-UUID input - correct defensive behavior.

When DB migration is not applied, modal shows 'loading spinner' and never transitions to exam editor, so Import CSV button is never visible. This is migration-dependent and EXPECTED until 0043 is applied.
